retention.reportPersonalContent: Current main redacts personal report fields at receipt +90 days; skeleton/audit/receipt records remain. Historical D1 versions can retain pre-redaction data; this is not physical erasure.
retention.photos: Current main R2 design: access closes 24 hours before the report-receipt +90-day deadline; provider physical erasure is not proven. D1/crypto retention and destruction deadline are UNDECIDED; do not carry the R2 promise into D1 without evidence.
retention.deviceFollowUp: Current main: report ID, consent version, estimated deadline and photo count only, at most 89 days; no image bytes. This is not a guaranteed D1 upload window; server deadline must remain authoritative.
retention.appAttest: Key registration/revocation retention is separate; no blanket 90-day deletion promise.
retention.supportAndProvider: Not established by report retention. Owner must confirm.
